title: Ontology Refinement with Embeddings and LLMs: A Case Study on CASTON
abstract: arXiv:2610.21466v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ontologies are widely used to represent and organize complex knowledge in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare. However, constructing reliable ontologies remains challenging, as class hierarchies, whether manually or automatically constructed, may contain subtle subsumption errors that require careful refinement. We study this problem in CASTON, a casting-domain ontology, and present a lightweight but scalable refinement workflow that combines a fine-tuned ontology embedding model with Large Language Models (LLMs). The embedding model is used to extract a limited number of candidate axioms for refinement together with possible replacement candidates, and an LLM then returns repair suggestions. In a small expert evaluation, the default configuration using a CASTON-fine-tuned OnT embedding model and Qwen3-8B produced reliable high-confidence repairs: all six high-confidence replacements were accepted by both domain experts. translated_title: 基于嵌入模型与大语言模型的本体细化：CASTON案例研究
translated_abstract: 本体被广泛应用于生物医学和医疗保健等领域中复杂知识的表示与组织。然而，构建可靠的本体仍然具有挑战性，因为无论是手工构建还是自动构建的类层次结构，都可能包含需要仔细修正的细微包含（subsumption）错误。我们在铸造领域本体CASTON中研究了这一问题，提出了一种轻量级但可扩展的细化工作流，该工作流将经过微调的本体嵌入模型与大语言模型（LLM）相结合。嵌入模型用于提取有限数量的待修正候选公理及可能的替换候选，随后由大语言模型给出修复建议。在一项小型专家评估中，使用CASTON微调的OnT嵌入模型与Qwen3-8B的默认配置产生了可靠的高置信度修复：全部六项高置信度替换建议均被领域专家接受。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合微调本体嵌入模型与大语言模型的轻量级可扩展本体细化工作流，在铸造领域本体CASTON上的专家评估表明，其高置信度修复建议全部获得领域专家认可。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a lightweight, scalable ontology refinement workflow that combines a fine-tuned ontology embedding model with LLMs, and an expert evaluation on the CASTON casting-domain ontology shows that all its high-confidence repair suggestions were accepted by domain experts.
